name: Substack Export Import
changes: Save profile, Load profile and Compare bodies now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button.
The Sponsor on GitHub button adds the plugin id to the GitHub address, so a sponsorship shows its source.
If GitHub has said you sponsor, or your first check still runs, no Sponsor button shows.
tip: The local file picker can read a Substack export that is outside the vault, so you do not need to copy the export in first.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Substack Export Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
